HediffDef.label: Whispers acoustic sensory node
HediffDef.description: A neural-auditory implant grown from studied Whispers tissue. It greatly amplifies hearing and improves rapid localisation of nearby movement without reproducing the source hybrid's blindness.

HediffDef.label: Whispers mist gland
HediffDef.description: A cultured neck-gill implant derived from Whispers tissue. The gland continuously exudes non-toxic obscuring biological mist around the bearer in a ten-tile radius, exactly as in a native Whispers hybrid. This passive effect requires no activation or cooldown.
